FLOATING_BUBBLES.name: Floating bubbles
FLOATING_BUBBLES.instruction: Follow the rhythm of the circle while you watch the bubbles rise. There is no right way to do it.

COLOR_WAVES.name: Color waves
COLOR_WAVES.instruction: Breathe with the circle while the colors move like waves. You can keep looking at the color you like most.

STARRY_SKY.name: Starry sky
STARRY_SKY.instruction: Breathe with the circle while the stars slowly twinkle. If you like, pick one and follow it with your eyes.

GENTLE_RAIN.name: Gentle rain
GENTLE_RAIN.instruction: Listen to the rain falling slowly and breathe with the circle. You don't have to do anything else.

OCEAN_SOUNDS.name: Ocean sounds
OCEAN_SOUNDS.instruction: Listen to the waves come and go, and breathe in and out with them. You can close your eyes if it helps.

RELAXING_PIANO.name: Relaxing piano
RELAXING_PIANO.instruction: Listen to the slow piano notes and let your breathing follow their rhythm. There is no right way to do it.
